title in the In one list view.
# Sidebar Workspace Names — DeepSeek Harness
**See which workspace a session belongs to, without leaving the sidebar's _In one list_ view.**
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The flat session list mixes sessions from every workspace, so a title alone does not
say where the s

ession lives. This plugin puts the owning workspace on a second line
under the title, and keeps the
full, untruncated name in the row's hover card.
## What you get

- **In one list** (`View options → Group by → In one list`) renders each session as a
two-line row:

title and relative time on top, the workspace name below.
- Sessions that belong to no registered wo

rkspace read **Ungrouped**.
- The automatic default workspace reads as a localized "Default workspac

e".
- **Grouped** and **Workspace Tree** views are unchanged — their workspace headers
already name

the workspace.
- Hovering a row shows the full workspace name in the hover card, even when the
secon
d line had to truncate a long name.

install it from the Plugins page in the desktop app. Restart the profile

## How it works

It is an ordinary Cordis client plugin bundle — no harness source is patched, forked,
or monkey-patc

s an ordinary Cordis client plugin bundle — no harness source is patched, forked,
or monkey-patched:

- `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` hosts the workspace chip.
- `sidebar.session.row.hover` ho

sts the full name inside the hover card.
- A small stylesheet turns flat-view session rows into two-

line rows and scopes every
rule to the flat list, so grouped views keep their shipped 32px rows.

`client.js` ships as plain JavaScript on purpose: the harness injects client plugin
bundles into the

page as a classic script, so the file reaches the JS engine verbatim.
There is no build step and no
runtime type stripping in the browser.
## Known limits

- **Row DOM coupling.** The chip is placed relative to ui-workspace's session row
(`[data-row-key="s

ession:…"]`) and the always-mounted row action strip. That is a
decoration contract, not a public AP

I; `engines.dsh` pins the tested range, and a
harness change should get a plugin version bump.
- **T

he strip's own controls are hidden while the chip shows.** Because the chip shares
the strip with ar

chive/pin, those buttons are suppressed on flat rows and come back on
hover; a harness change to the

strip's markup can strand them visible.
- **`:has()` is required** for the flat-view scoping (Chrom

ium 105+, Safari 15.4+).
Without it the chip simply stays hidden.
- **Fixed two-line height.** Works

pace names longer than the line ellipsize; the hover
card carries the full name. Rows are 48px tall

in the flat view.
- **Blank New Session rows** have no action strip, so they keep the single-line he

ight.
- **No visual test.** The suite covers name resolution only; the layout is CSS against
another

sual test.** The suite covers name resolution only; the layout is CSS against
another package's DOM.
